explanations.11: This gets the parent directory of the current file's directory using two 'up' operations, so if your script is in project/src/script.py, BASE_DIR becomes project.
explanations.23: The f-string creates a prompt message that includes the actual blog post content, which will be sent to the AI model to analyze.
explanations.33: This tells the AI model to respond in JSON format rather than plain text, making the response easier to parse.
explanations.43: After getting the AI's response as a text string, we convert it from JSON text into a Python dictionary so we can access its fields.
explanations.46: The code checks two possible locations for tags because the AI might return the tags at the top level or nested inside another 'response' key.
